hooks.command: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch -q 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then m="WARNING: $(git branch --show-current) is $n commits behind $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{u}). Stop and sync before any work (AGENTS.md: Before you start)."; printf "{\"systemMessage\": \"%s\", \"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"SessionStart\", \"additionalContext\": \"%s\"}}\n" "$m" "$m"; fi
